title: Book of Enoch cut from the Tanakh

tellings.quote: backstory here. And you find the backstory preserved in the book of Enoch, which was first discovered in Ethiopia. And he clearly was at one point part of the Tanakh and was excised,

plain: The Book of Enoch, an ancient religious text first found in Ethiopia, was once part of the Tanakh, the Hebrew Bible, and was later cut out of it. That is the claim of the researcher and philosopher Jason Jorjani, who gives it as his own summary without naming a source. He says the book keeps a "backstory" that the shorter account in Genesis 6 leaves out. If he is right, it would mean a key part of the old story was deliberately removed from the scriptures.
